summary: SM Energy Company filed an 8-K reporting completion of its South Texas Divestiture on April 30, 2026, pursuant to a Purchase and Sale Agreement with Caturus Energy, LLC for approximately 61,000 net acres in Webb County, Texas. Net cash proceeds of ~$900 million were received, subject to post-closing adjustments. SM Energy intends to use the proceeds to redeem $819 million aggregate principal of its 6.75% and 5.0% Senior Notes due 2026. The borrowing base was reaffirmed at $5.0 billion. No board recommendation or advisor disclosed. The sale does not qualify as discontinued operations. Watch for final purchase price adjustments and impact on debt reduction.
